The '''Destruction of Xizor's Palace''' entailed a mission by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to rescue the imprisoned [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from the clutches of [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] and the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. After rescuing the princess, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] dropped a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] into one of the [[Xizor's Palace|palace's]] garbage chutes, destroying the structure, and crippling the Black Sun organization.<ref name="SOTE" />
